seriesTitle: History of the World: Part II

episodes.title: I
episodes.summary: General Grant heads out in search of a drink; After the Russian Tsar is executed, Shmuck Mudman and his family head to Moscow; Shakespeare's Writers Room; Invention of Fire; The REAL Kama Sutra.

episodes.title: II
episodes.summary: Judas betrays Jesus; Shirley Chisholm makes a big announcement. General Grant finds himself in trouble and Marco Polo meets Kublai Khan.

episodes.title: III
episodes.summary: Alexander Graham Bells makes (and receives) a call; Shmuck Mudman gains access to the politburo; Sigmund Freud teaches psychoanalysis.

episodes.title: IV
episodes.summary: Jesus and Mary fall in love; Shmuck and Fanny Mudman change the course of Russian history; How the Pyramids were built.

episodes.title: V
episodes.summary: Galileo is on TikTok; General Grant gets rescued; Shirley Chisholm meets George Wallace.

episodes.title: VI
episodes.summary: Amelia Earhart's fate revealed; Jesus and the Fab 13 try to record the last sermon; The Civil War ends; Statues get removed.

episodes.title: VII
episodes.summary: Middle East peace (and lunch) in Oslo; Shirley Chisholm heads to the Watergate; Jesus and the band play their final concert.

episodes.title: VIII
episodes.summary: The Berlin Wall comes down; Christianity gets a makeover; Shirley Chisholm speaks at the DNC.
